# Clickable Cell Icons

A cell renderer can return a `<cell-icon>` element to show one of the built-in icons in a cell. The icon works like a button: when the user clicks it (or focuses it and presses Enter or Space), the component raises the **Cell Icon Clicked** event. You don't need to write any click handling in the renderer.

Clickable cell icons work in [Worksheets](../../workbooks/components/worksheet.md), [Tables](../../workbooks/components/table.md), [SQL Reports](../../workbooks/components/reports.md) and [Table Views](../../workbooks/components/tableview.md).

<br/>

**Example**

This renderer shows an icon based on the cell's value. Clicking it raises the Cell Icon Clicked event.

```javascript
function(eventArgs, services){
    // Map your own cell values to icon names. A value that already is an icon name is used as it is.
    const iconNames = { 'Open': 'popup', 'Total': 'sum' };

    const icon = document.createElement('cell-icon');
    icon.setAttribute('name', iconNames[eventArgs.value] ?? eventArgs.value);
    icon.setAttribute('title', 'Open details');
    return icon;
}
```

> [!TIP]
> In the Designer, the **Clickable icon** sample in the Renderer editor gives you this code to start from.

---

## Icon names

Set the `name` attribute to one of these names. Names are not case sensitive. An unknown name shows nothing.

The icon uses the cell's text color, so it stays visible on selected rows and in every theme.

---

## Attributes and properties

**name**
The name of the icon to show. See [Icon names](#icon-names).

**title**
The tooltip, also read by screen readers. If you don't set it, the icon name is used.

**align**
Where the icon sits horizontally in the cell: `left`, `center` or `right`.

**valign**
Where the icon sits vertically in the cell: `top`, `middle` or `bottom`. This is only visible in rows that are taller than the icon, for example when another column wraps its text.

You can set `align` and `valign` as attributes or as properties:

```javascript
icon.align = 'left';
icon.valign = 'top';
```

By default the icon is centered in the cell. If the column's **Content Alignment** is Center or Right, that is used instead. Content Alignment Left is treated as not set, so use `icon.align = 'left'` to put the icon on the left. `align` and `valign` always win over Content Alignment.

> [!NOTE]
> The default centering and `align`/`valign` apply when the renderer returns the `<cell-icon>` itself. If you wrap the icon in another element, you control its placement with that element.

---

## The Cell Icon Clicked event

Add an event handler for **Cell Icon Clicked** on the component to act on the click. The event args contain:

**Data**
The data (row) object of the clicked cell.

**Sender.ColumnName**
The name of the column that was clicked.

**CellValue**
The value of the clicked cell.

**IconName**
The `name` of the icon that was clicked.

**Example**

Use `IconName` when a column can show different icons, for example to open a different popup per icon:

# [JavaScript](#tab/cell-icon-clicked-javascript)
```javascript
_state.customerId = Event.Data.CustomerId;
_state.clickedIcon = Event.IconName;
```
# [Eaze](#tab/cell-icon-clicked-eaze)
```javascript
_state.customerId = @Event.Data.CustomerId;
_state.clickedIcon = @Event.IconName;
```
